Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with acute onset left-sided chest discomfort/pressure.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: PC: acute onset left sided chest discomfort / pressure

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Chest discomfort is described as a pressure sensation "like someone sitting on his chest" and is rated 7/10 in intensity.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: feels like someone sitting on his chest 7/10

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Chest discomfort radiates to the left shoulder and arm.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: radiating to the left shoulder and arm.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The episode of chest discomfort has lasted 1–2 hours so far.
The first episode started while the patient was gardening.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 1-2 hours in duration, acute onset, 1st presentation started while gardening.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: There is no radiation of pain to the head.
Patient complains of nausea without vomiting since presentation.
Patient experiences shortness of breath at rest.
There is a longer-term history of reduced activities of daily living due to shortness of breath on exertion.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: longer term hx of reduced ADLs due to SOBOE

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Previously the patient could walk up hills and stairs without chest discomfort.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: walking up hills / stairs with no chest discomfort.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has a history of high cholesterol (hyperlipidemia).
Patient has a history of high blood pressure (hypertension).

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives at home with his wife.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: SHx - lives with wife at home

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient was previously able to walk up stairs without difficulty.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: able to walk up stairs until previously

Assessment.content: Differential diagnosis includes gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD).

Plan_of_Care.content: An ambulance was called for suspected myocardial infarction and further investigation and assessment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Plan - called ambulance ?? MI for further investigation and assessment.
